problems.why: Finding 1 complains about repetition, but it is about the fund-list feature chips, not the colour key repeated under each account row's cost bar, and no other finding names that key.
Finding 5 says that in the account rows you have to match the bar's colour squares to the numbers beside them, which is the same back-and-forth between colour and amount.
No finding says the account rows repeat the colour key on every row; finding 1 is about repeated fund feature chips in the fund list, which is a different element.
Finding 5 says the account-row cost bars make you match small colour squares to the numbers beside them, which is the person's back-and-forth between colour and amount.
